definitions.explanation: A man who has legally adopted a child and become their father, or who raises a child in place of their biological father. A formal, legal term.

examples.japanese: {養父|ようふ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: I was raised by my adoptive father.

examples.japanese: {養父|ようふ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良好|りょうこう}→良好：13954_ryoukou⟧だった。
examples.english: My relationship with my adoptive father was good.

examples.japanese: {養父|ようふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My adoptive father treated me as preciously as a biological father would.

notes:
{養父|ようふ} is a formal, legal term for an adoptive or foster father — a man who raises a child not biologically his own.

WRITING:
{養|よう} (nurture, adopt) + {父|ふ} (father). The character {養|よう} appears in many adoption-related words.

REGISTER:
A legal and formal term. In casual conversation, ⟦{育|そだ}て→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ (the parent who raised me) or ⟦{育|そだ}て→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧ is more natural.

RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
- ⟦{養母|ようぼ}→養母：21105_youbo⟧: adoptive mother
- ⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧: adopted child
- ⟦{養親|ようしん}→養親：16814_youshin⟧: adoptive parent
- ⟦{実父|じっぷ}→実父：22861_jippu⟧: biological father

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{義父|ぎふ}→義父：06725_gifu⟧ (father-in-law), which refers to a spouse's father. {養父|ようふ} specifically means an adoptive/foster father.
